    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: local-demo
      MYSQL_DATABASE: course
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-plocal-demo"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

    build: .
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: mysql
      DB_PASSWORD: local-demo
      NAMES_FILE: /data/names.txt
    volumes:

    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
volumes:
  mysql-data:
  names-data:

.git
*.log
names.txt

external: Docker Engine and the MySQL image are required. Build the JAR with Maven, then run docker compose up --build from this folder. choices: The source mounts /app and later encounters an old JAR masking a rebuild. This completed reconstruction puts writable names data under /data so the mount cannot conceal /app/app.jar. MySQL uses its own volume. The healthcheck orders startup; neither change adds a new application feature.
